identity.title: Open English WordNet 2025 ASCII multiword verb-form inventory

construct.unit: OEWN verb entry containing two or more space-separated ASCII alphabetic members
construct.population_or_exposure_claim: lexicographic membership in the pinned OEWN 2025 projection

source.creator_or_rights_holder: Open English WordNet Team and Princeton University

known_biases: lexicographic coverage is not corpus representativeness
ASCII space-separated projection excludes other orthographic forms

processing.input_tokenizer_mapping: exact lowercase canonical-form lookup after whitespace collapse
processing.normalization: curly apostrophe to straight, lowercase, collapse whitespace; retain only ASCII alphabetic members
processing.mwe_matching_policy: lookup occurs only after human occurrence confirmation; exact canonical-form membership
processing.sense_mapping_policy: sense count is descriptive inventory metadata; no contextual assignment

table.format: JSON; compact array rows nested in this manifest

measurement.numerator_definition: confirmed MWE occurrences or distinct confirmed canonical forms matched in rows
measurement.denominator_definition: confirmed MWE occurrences or distinct confirmed canonical forms, reported separately
measurement.missing_item_policy: retain as out_of_inventory; do not reject the occurrence or infer non-MWE status
measurement.zero_denominator_policy: value is null; preserve numerator and denominator

rights.required_attribution: Open English WordNet Team and Princeton University WordNet

validation.browser_size_or_latency_evidence: Node 24.9.0 arm64 smoke check on 2026-09-01: 52,420 bytes, JSON parse 0.6 ms, Map build 0.2 ms; real-browser latency remains a release-gate test
validation.removal_or_replacement_procedure: delete this profile and its fetch/use/tests; preserve explicit out_of_inventory states and old releases where lawful
